items.source: Note, that you shouldn't register PropertyEditor bean instances via the customEditors property as PropertyEditors are stateful and the instances will then have to be synchronized for every editing attempt. In case you need control over the instantiation process of PropertyEditors, use a PropertyEditorRegistrar to register them.
items.translation: 请注意，不应通过 `customEditors` 属性注册 `PropertyEditor` Bean 实例，因为 `PropertyEditors` 是有状态的，因此每次编辑尝试时都必须对实例进行同步。如果您需要控制 `PropertyEditors` 的实例化过程，请使用 `PropertyEditorRegistrar` 来注册它们。

items.source: In case you want to register PropertyEditor instances, the recommended usage is to use custom PropertyEditorRegistrar implementations that in turn register any desired editor instances on a given registry. Each PropertyEditorRegistrar can register any number of custom editors.
items.translation: 如果您想注册 `PropertyEditor` 实例，建议的做法是使用自定义的 PropertyEditorRegistrar 实现，这些实现进而将任何所需的编辑器实例注册到给定的 registry 上。每个 `PropertyEditorRegistrar` 可以注册任意数量的自定义编辑器。

items.source: It's perfectly fine to register PropertyEditor classes via the customEditors property. Spring will create fresh instances of them for each editing attempt then:
items.translation: 通过 `customEditors` 属性注册 `PropertyEditor 类是完全没问题的。Spring 随后将为每次编辑尝试创建这些类的实例：

items.source: NOTE: Custom property editors registered with this configurer do not apply to data binding. Custom editors for data binding need to be registered on the DataBinder: Use a common base class or delegate to common PropertyEditorRegistrar implementations to reuse editor registration there.
items.translation: 注意：使用此配置器注册的自定义属性编辑器不适用于数据绑定。用于数据绑定的自定义编辑器需要在 DataBinder 上进行注册：请使用公共基类或委托给通用的 PropertyEditorRegistrar 实现，以便在那里重用编辑器注册。

items.source: This allows for sharing PropertyEditorRegistrars with DataBinders, etc. Furthermore, it avoids the need for synchronization on custom editors: A PropertyEditorRegistrar will always create fresh editor instances for each bean creation attempt.
items.translation: 这允许与DataBinders等共享PropertyEditorRegistrars。此外，它避免了在自定义编辑器上进行同步的需要：PropertyEditorRegistrar将为每次 bean 创建尝试创建新的编辑器实例。

items.source: Also supports "java.lang.String[]"-style array class names and primitive class names (for example, "boolean"). Delegates to ClassUtils for actual class name resolution.
items.translation: 同时也支持类似"java.lang.String[]"的数组类名和原始类名（例如，"boolean"）。实际类名解析委托给 ClassUtils。

items.source: Specify the custom editors to register via a Map, using the class name of the required type as the key and the class name of the associated PropertyEditor as value.
items.translation: 通过 `Map` 注册自定义编辑器，使用所需类型的类名作为键，关联的 `PropertyEditor` 的类名作为值。

items.source: Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).

items.source:
Modify the application context's internal bean factory after its standard
initialization. All bean definitions will have been loaded, but no beans
will have been instantiated yet. This allows for overriding or adding
properties even to eager-initializing beans.
items.translation: 在标准初始化之后修改应用程序上下文内部的 Bean 工厂。此时所有 Bean 定义都已被加载，但尚未实例化任何 Bean。这允许您甚至对急切初始化的 Bean 进行属性覆盖或添加。
